command.description: Dev command to run when none is given after --. A string runs in a shell.

url.description: App URL; detected from the command output when omitted

webRoot.description: Folder the dev server serves from, relative to this file

backend.description: Remote backend origins to tag with the trace header

roots.description: Workspace roots, relative to this file

ignore.description: Globs for workspace files to leave out of traces, like "src/generated/**"

settleMs.description: Quiet time that ends a click (ms)

headless.description: Run the browser without a window
